facts.summary: North Dakota basic state minimum wage listed by U.S. DOL: $7.25.
facts.evidence_quote: Basic Minimum Rate (per hour): $7.25 Premium Pay After Designated Hours 1 : Weekly - 40
facts.source_title: State Minimum Wage Laws (U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division)
